reading: And [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] [[was seeing|was seeing, was perceiving, was beholding, was looking at|ὁράω]] [[the sound|the sound and tone, the sound of the voice, the cry, the faculty of speech and discourse, the language, the saying|φωνή]] and [[the torches|the torches, the beacon-lights, the oil-lamps, the lights, the torch-races, the races|λαμπάς]] and [[the sound|the sound and tone, the sound of the voice, the cry, the faculty of speech and discourse, the language, the saying|φωνή]] [[of the war-trumpet|of the war-trumpet and trump, of the trumpet-call|σάλπιγξ]] and [[the mountain|the mountain and hill|ὄρος]] [[the thing making smoke|the thing making smoke, making a fire, smoking and blackening with smoke, being black with smoke|καπνίζω]]; [[having been put to flight|having been put to flight, having fled affrighted, having fled, having been seized with fear, having been affrighted, having feared|φοβέομαι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] [[were set|were set, were placed and stood, were there, were in a state and condition, lay and were situated, stood still and stopped and halted, stood idle, stopped and ceased and were at rest, stood firm, stood up and rose up, arose and began|ἵστημι]] [[from afar|from afar, from long since|μακρόθεν]].

greek: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Μωυσῆν Λάλησον σὺ ἡμῖν, καὶ μὴ λαλείτω πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός, μήποτε ἀποθάνωμεν.
hint: They ask Moses to speak to them himself, and that God not speak to them, lest they die.

notes.text: Let him not talk, the present imperative, third singular.
God, for the Hebrew ʾĕlōhîm.

reading: and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[talk|talk, chat, prattle, babble, say, talk of, speak, chatter, chirp|λαλέω]] you to us, and [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[let talk|let talk, let chat, let prattle, let babble, let say, let talk of, let speak, let chatter, let chirp|λαλέω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] us [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]], [[that at no time|that at no time and lest ever, never and on no account, perhaps|μήποτε]] [[we may die off|we may die off and die, we may be put to death and slain|ἀποθνήσκω]].

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")

greek: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς Θαρσεῖτε· ἕνεκεν γὰρ τοῦ πειράσαι ὑμᾶς παρεγενήθη ὁ θεὸς πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ὅπως ἂν γένηται ὁ φόβος αὐτοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν, ἵνα μὴ ἁμαρτάνητε.
hint: Moses tells them to take courage: God has come to test them, so that fear of him may keep them from sin.

notes.text: On account of the making proof, the articular infinitive after ἕνεκεν.
That ever it may come to be, ὅπως with ἄν and the subjunctive.
Says, the present among aorists.

reading: and [[says|says, speaks, declares, calls by name, tells|λέγω]] to them [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[be of good courage|be of good courage and take courage, be over-bold and audacious, have confidence in, venture|θαρσέω]]; [[on account of|on account of, for the sake of, because of, for, as far as regards|ἕνεκα]] [[for|for, since and as, for otherwise and else, now, but, why and what, would that|γάρ]], [[of the making proof|of the making proof and trial of, of the attempting, of the trying and tempting, of the putting to the test|πειράζω]] you [[was beside|was beside / was by / near / attended upon, was present at, came to one's side and came to aid and stood by and seconded and supported, was at hand and was gained and accrued, came to, arrived and came up, came to maturity, was fully grown|παραγίνομαι]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] you, [[that|that, in order that|ὅπως]] ever [[may come into being|may come to be, may arise, may be brought into existence|γίνομαι]] [[the flight|the flight, the panic fear, the fear and terror, the outward show of fear, the object of terror|φόβος]] of him [[in|within, inside of, and by means of|ἐν]] to you, [[that|that, in order that|ἵνα]] [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[you may miss the mark|you may miss the mark, you may fail of your purpose, you may go wrong, you may err, you may sin|ἁμαρτάνω]].

greek: εἱστήκει δὲ ὁ λαὸς μακρόθεν, Μωυσῆς δὲ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν γνόφον, οὗ ἦν ὁ θεός.
hint: The people stay at a distance while Moses goes into the darkness where God is.

notes.text: The pluperfect of ἵστημι, the intransitive: had been set, and stood so.
γνόφος, darkness, dusk, gloom, for the Hebrew ʿărāpel.
Where God was, ἦν with its formula.

reading: [[had been set|had been set and stood so, had been placed and stood, had been there, had been in a state and condition, had lain and been situated, had stood still and stopped and halted, had stood idle, had stopped and ceased and been at rest, had stood firm, had stood up and risen up, had arisen and begun|ἵστημι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] [[from afar|from afar, from long since|μακρόθεν]], [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[went in|went in, went into and entered, came into, came in, came upon|εἰσέρχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the darkness|the darkness and dusk and gloom|γνόφος]], where was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]].

greek: Εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Τάδε ἐρεῖς τῷ οἴκῳ Ιακωβ καὶ ἀναγγελεῖς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ Ὑμεῖς ἑωράκατε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λελάληκα πρὸς ὑμᾶς·
hint: The lord gives Moses a message for the house of Jacob: they have seen him speak to them from heaven.

notes.text: To the house of Jacob, and you will report: the Hebrew has only ʾel-bĕnê yiśrāʾēl, to the sons of Israel; the Greek's pair is 19:3's.
The perfect: I have talked, and it stands so.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[lord|lord / master, the head, master, the Lord, Jehovah|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[these|these, the immediate present, here and on the spot, thus, hither and to this spot, therefore and on this account|ὅδε]] [[you will say|you will say, you will speak, you will declare, you will call by name, you will tell|λέγω]] [[to the house|to the house and abode and dwelling, to the room and chamber, to the house of a god and temple, to the household goods and substance, to the household and family|οἶκος]] of [[name:Ιακωβ]] and [[you will carry back tidings of|you will carry back tidings of / report|ἀναγγέλλω]] to the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] you [[you have seen|you have seen and it stands so, you have perceived and it stands so, you have beheld and it stands so, you have looked at and it stands so|ὁράω]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the heaven|of the heaven, of the vault, of the firmament and the sky|οὐρανός]] [[I have talked|I have talked and it stands so, I have chatted, I have prattled, I have babbled, I have said, I have talked of, I have spoken, I have chattered, I have chirped|λαλέω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] you;

names.gloss: (Ιακωβ, from Hebrew Yaʿăqōb, which the Hebrew of Genesis 25:26 hears in ʿāqēb, "heel")
(Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: οὐ ποιήσετε ἑαυτοῖς θεοὺς ἀργυροῦς καὶ θεοὺς χρυσοῦς οὐ ποιήσετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς.
hint: They are not to make gods of silver or gold for themselves.

notes.text: For yourselves: the Hebrew has ʾittî, with me, at the first clause.
To you yourselves, αὐτοῖς intensive with the pronoun.

reading: not [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to yourselves [[gods|gods, the gods, goddesses|θεός]] [[silver|silver and of silver|ἀργυροῦς]] and [[gods|gods, the gods, goddesses|θεός]] [[golden|golden, of gold, decked and inlaid with gold, gilded and gilt, gold-coloured and golden-yellow|χρυσοῦς]] not [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to you to yourselves.

greek: θυσιαστήριον ἐκ γῆς ποιήσετέ μοι καὶ θύσετε ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰ σωτήρια ὑμῶν, τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς μόσχους ὑμῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, οὗ ἐὰν ἐπονομάσω τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἥξω πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐλογήσω σε.
hint: An altar of earth is to be made for offerings, and wherever the lord's name is named he will come and bless.

notes.text: The things of deliverance, σωτήριος as a noun, for the Hebrew šĕlāmêkā, your peace offerings.
Where ever I may name: the Hebrew has ʾazkîr, I cause to be remembered; ἐάν after the relative is ἄν, plain text.
θυσιαστήριον, an altar, one translation, plain text.

reading: an altar [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of earth|of earth, of land, of ground|γῆ]] [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] to me and [[you will offer|you will offer, you will burn, you will sacrifice, you will slaughter and slay, you will offer sacrifices, you will celebrate with offerings|θύω]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] of it [[the whole burnt-offerings|the whole burnt-offerings and holocausts|ὁλοκαύτωμα]] and [[the deliverances|the deliverances and safeties, the thankofferings for deliverance|σωτήριος]] of you, [[the things that walk forward|the things that walk forward, the cattle, the flocks and herds, the horses, the small cattle, the sheep|πρόβατον]] and [[the calves|the calves, the young bulls, the heifers and young cows, the boys and girls and maids, the young animals|μόσχος]] of you [[in all|within, inside of, and by means of all, the whole, every, every single|ἐν; πᾶς]] [[to place|to place, to local circumstances, to position, to passage in a book, to topic, to common-place, to occasion and opportunity|τόπος]], where ever [[I may give a surname|I may give a surname, I may name, I may call, I may pronounce|ἐπονομάζω]] [[the name|the name, the fame, the mere name, the phrase and expression|ὄνομα]] of me [[there|there, in that place|ἐκεῖ]], and [[I will have come|I will have come, I will be present, I will be here, I will have returned, I will have reached a point|ἥκω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] you and [[I will speak well of|I will speak well of, I will praise, I will honour, I will bless|εὐλογέω]] you.

greek: ἐὰν δὲ θυσιαστήριον ἐκ λίθων ποιῇς μοι, οὐκ οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτοὺς τμητούς· τὸ γὰρ ἐγχειρίδιόν σου ἐπιβέβληκας ἐπʼ αὐτούς, καὶ μεμίανται.
hint: A stone altar must not be of hewn stones; putting a blade to them defiles them.

notes.text: Your hand-knife: the Hebrew has ḥarbĕkā, your sword. ἐγχειρίδιον is filed in Middle Liddell as the noun inside ἐγχειρίδιος, a hand-knife, dagger.
Two perfects, the state standing. μεμίανται is the third singular, as the module codes it, the plural of this stem being a participle with εἰσί; its subject is not expressed.
τμητός, cut, shaped by cutting, the verbal adjective, for the Hebrew gāzît, hewn stone.

greek: οὐκ ἀναβήσῃ ἐν ἀναβαθμίσιν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριόν μου, ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἀποκαλύψῃς τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην σου ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ.
hint: There are to be no steps up to the altar, so that nakedness is not exposed on it.
